Hi Jordan —

Just confirming our 30-min office hours slot today at 3:00 PM PT to walk through the API key handshake and initial SDK wiring. I attached a short quickstart and the SDK setup doc to speed things up if you want to skim ahead.

Agenda (high level):
- Quick infra/stack check (env, dev VM, network policy)
- Create/test API key + sample call (curl + node)
- SDK integration point (auth, streaming vs non-streaming)
- Troubleshooting time for any blocker you hit

Attachments: redwood-quickstart.pdf (1 page), sdk-setup.md (guide)
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-acme-onboarding

If you need to add your engineer to the invite, feel free to forward — I'll keep the session focused on the handshake and token perms.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafal.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0128

Sorry about that — we had a production incident downstream and I got pulled into the on-call loop. Apologies for the no-show; completely my fault.

We still want the walkthrough. Miles (our backend lead) would also like to join — cc'd. Our availability next week (all PT):
- Tue 12/1: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed 12/2: 09:00–10:00
- Thu 12/3: 13:00–14:30

2) Walkthrough SDK auth flow (node) and the recommended pattern for streaming vs short-lived requests
3) Troubleshoot a failing sample request we tried (403 when exchanging token)

Also, can you share any checklist we should complete before the call so we can have a working example ready? Appreciate it — Jordan

I can offer these concrete slots (all PT) — pick one and I'll send a calendar invite to you and Miles:
- Tue 12/1 10:30–11:00 (30 min) — quick focused handshake + check of perms
- Tue 12/1 15:00–15:45 (45 min) — buffer for troubleshooting the sample request
- Wed 12/2 09:30–10:15 (45 min) — later option in case you need to prep

Quick notes: please have a dev machine with node installed, the sample request + full request/response (curl output or terminal copy) for the 403, and the service account email you want to scope the key to. If you're behind a corporate proxy, let us know and we'll adjust instructions.
